name: Audit local repaired password reset flow
description: Local audit-copy regression only. Use a nonexistent account and invalid reset token; do not create an account or send email.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /forgot-password on the local app, enter unknown@example.com, and click Send reset link.
Verify the page shows the generic acknowledgement Check your inbox and does not reveal whether the account exists.
Navigate to /reset-password?token=invalid-audit-token on the local app, enter the same generated password twice, and click Update password.
Verify a clear invalid or already-used reset-link error is shown and the page does not report a successful password change.
